title: Adjust Mask Straps
visual_summary: Patient sitting up tightening side mask straps evenly to reduce air leakage.
narration_summary: If your mask is leaking Try small, even strap adjustments. Until it feels secure and comfortable.

start_scene_0_3s.description: Identifies mask leak issue and air escaping around cushion.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Demonstrates pulling top and bottom headgear straps evenly.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Shows properly fitted mask with comfortable seal.

cues.text: Until it feels secure and comfortable.
